units.name: Ordinary Zobo
units.description: A smelly Ordinary Zobo.
units.lore: Your average 9-to-5 Zobo who shambles into battle with the same energy as clocking in on Monday.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Claws at enemies to deal damage.

units.name: Psycho Zobo
units.description: An Ordinary Zobo who escaped from a mental asylum.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Claws at enemies.

units.name: Fisherman Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo who attacks from a distance.
units.lore: There he goes again. Flaunting that fish he caught last year like it's still fresh! (FYI: It's not.)

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws fish that deal damage.

units.name: Matchstick Zobo
units.description: A Fire Zobo that explodes when destroyed.
units.lore: "ART IS AN EXPLOSION!"

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Slashes with a matchstick to deal damage. Detonates upon being knocked down, dealing small AoE damage.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Explodes.

units.name: Plant Zobo
units.description: A Grass Zobo who attacks from a distance.
units.lore: "A Zobo trying to fuse with plants to achieve photosynthesis. If it succeeds, it could live forever just by sunbathing!" —Unnamed Log

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Tosses veggie baskets that deal damage.

units.name: Miner Zobo
units.description: A Rock Zobo that digs tunnels to sneak up behind Tatari.
units.lore: Miner mischief! Digging way off the beaten path!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Attacks with a shovel to deal damage. Upon first meeting an enemy, moves behind it.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Tunnels forward.

units.name: Rocker Zobo
units.description: A Lightning Zobo that speeds up when at low HP.
units.lore: Those "headphones"? Yeah... they're actually zappy motivators. Who knew Zobos could run this fast?

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws punches that deal damage. At low HP, movement speed is increased.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Starts running.

units.name: Tumbleweed Zobo
units.description: A Grass Zobo whose head keeps fighting even after it's destroyed.
units.lore: "Let's split up!"—These were the last words he said to his buddies before he turned into a Zobo.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws punches that deal damage. Upon being knocked down, its head survives and attacks with its teeth.

units.name: Cowboy Zobo
units.description: A Rock Zobo who attacks from a distance.
units.lore: Even Zobos can't escape their past. This one's still repping the Vanderlinde logo!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws stones that deal damage.

units.name: Junker Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo who takes less ranged damage.
units.lore: "What sets Zobos apart from regular creatures? They use car doors as weapons." —Zobologist Chuck

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Smashes a car door to deal damage. Takes less damage from ranged attacks.

units.name: Landlady Zobo
units.description: A Fire Zobo who attacks from a distance.
units.lore: "Oh honey, turning into a Zobo doesn't mean rent's free. HEY! Who threw the fire extinguisher?!"

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Tosses fire extinguishers that deal damage.

units.name: Nurse Zobo
units.description: A Lightning Zobo that throws syringes to paralyze its targets.
units.lore: When a Zobo starts to regain their sanity, this one gives 'em a lil' jab to keep 'em nice and brain-dead!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws syringes that deal damage and inflict Paralysis.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Deals a linked Paralysis damage tick.

units.name: Patient Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo that shakes in place when encountering its enemies.
units.lore: This Zobo just shivers in place and never moves an inch. Nurse Zobo's favorite patient to patch up!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings an IV bag to deal damage. Upon seeing an enemy, trembles with fear.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Trembles in fear.

units.name: Firehead Zobo
units.description: A Fire Zobo who runs fast but slows down when at low HP.
units.lore: This Zobo's life goals: (1) Hoard pinballs (2) Buy a bike (3) Legally change name to "Johnny Blazer"

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings forcefully to deal damage. At low HP, movement speed is reduced.

units.name: Clerk Zobo
units.description: A Grass Zobo who jumps to a neighboring row when hit a certain number of times.
units.lore: Unlike the other Zobos, this one is smart enough that it might get promoted to Manager Zobo.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Claws at enemies to deal damage. After being attacked a certain number of times, leaps to another row.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Jumps forward.

units.name: Digger Zobo
units.description: A Rock Zobo that digs a large ditch in front of itself upon spawning.
units.lore: "This Zobo can drive mine carts. Will they be driving monster trucks next?!" —Unnamed Log

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Attacks with a pickaxe to deal damage. After appearing, uses tunnels to quickly move a certain distance.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Tunnels forward.

units.name: Hockey Zobo
units.description: A Lightning Zobo that jumps frequently and jumps over Tatari after attacking.
units.lore: This Zobo always picks the easier path, yet somehow might reach the finish line first. C'mon, buddy.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swipes its hockey stick to deal damage. Periodically leaps to another row.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Jumps forward.

units.name: Hanger-On Zobo
units.description: A Grass Zobo who fights in melee and idolizes Shaman Zobos.
units.lore: Only appears when elite Zobos take the field. Hilariously incapable of combat. 9-to-5 Zobo may be a better choice.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Claws at enemies to deal damage.

units.name: Shotgun Zobo
units.description: A Grass Zobo who deals AoE attacks to enemies in front of it with its weapon.
units.lore: Bringing a dusty old gun to a Tatari fight? Seriously? Ten shots won't even scratch Rockzilla.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Shoots ahead to deal AoE damage.

units.name: Brick Zobo
units.description: A Rock Zobo with a long attack range who keeps pushing forward.
units.lore: Where does it even pull that many bricks from? The sled it's riding sure isn't a pocket dimension.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Tosses bricks that deal damage. Moves by sliding forward.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Jumps.

units.name: Battery Zobo
units.description: A Lightning Zobo who attacks from afar, but switches to melee when at low HP.
units.lore: Its real job is stealing e-bikes. Before flipping them for cash, it removes the batteries to use as weapons.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Fires small lightning bolts that deal damage. When at low HP, swings a power plug instead.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses an additional attack.

units.name: Kindling Zobo
units.description: A Fire Zobo who tosses hot stones and flaming stones that inflict Burn.
units.lore: Throwing rocks still hurts? Well... Nurse Zobos use syringes, so this makes sense.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Tosses hot stones that deal damage. After a certain number of attacks, tosses flaming stones that deal damage and inflict Burn.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses an additional attack.

skills.name: Special skill 2
skills.description: Deals a linked Burn damage tick.

units.name: Bugler Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo who grants buffs to its allies.
units.lore: It just single-handedly tanked team morale. I need the name of the Zobo who brought it on board. Now!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Sounds a horn, granting allies ATK Boost.

units.name: Dagger Zobo
units.description: A Lightning Zobo that throws two daggers at a time, though both may miss.
units.lore: Dagger Zobo can't juggle, but can show you a pretty cool (and lethal) knife trick.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws 2 daggers that often hit different targets to deal damage.

units.name: Trekker Zobo
units.description: A ranged Rock Zobo that speeds up its allies.
units.lore: "It's been observed through Trekker Zobo that calorie-dense foods allow Zobos to sprint a short distance."—Unnamed Log

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws a trekking pole to deal damage. Tosses chocolate to allies, granting them Haste.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses an additional attack.

units.name: Chemist Zobo
units.description: A melee Grass Zobo that throws bottles on the ground to heal allies.
units.lore: Chemist Zobo abhors machinery. Only alchemy—or modern chemistry—is reliable. Isn't that how Garden Zobo was made?

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Attacks with a vial to deal damage. Spends HP to smash a flask, healing allies in range.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses an additional attack.

units.name: Barrel Zobo
units.description: A Fire Zobo that hides inside a barrel to avoid danger.
units.lore: The world outside is too chaotic, and the Zobo Horde is just overwhelming. Only inside a barrel does Barrel Zobo find peace.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Attacks with fists to deal damage. When Frail, hides inside a barrel for a while and gains DEF Boost.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses an additional attack.

units.name: Surfer Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo that moves quickly upon spawning and can stun enemies.
units.lore: One of 'em might be Hydro Zobo's ex. You never know.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Stomps with its surfboard to deal damage. After appearing, moves quickly to attack and inflict Stun before bouncing back.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses an additional attack.

units.name: Arc-Punch Zobo
units.description: A Lightning Zobo that strikes with its fists and unleashes a piercing AoE punch.
units.lore: "Referee! I demand a glove inspection!" This Zobo has received a flood of complaints during boxing matches. With high-voltage cables wired to the insides of the gloves, you can guess what happens to the opponents.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Attacks with fists to deal damage. Occasionally throws a piercing punch.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses an additional attack.

units.name: Ripper Zobo
units.description: A Rock Zobo that heals itself through attacks.
units.lore: To stay warm on chilly peaks, hiking enthusiast Ripper Zobo wraps itself tight like a mummy, leaving only the eyes exposed. Ice axes just might be too annoying to use on the cliffs, though. How about a massive fanged jaw to latch onto things?

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Chomps down to deal damage. Heals itself based on damage dealt.

units.name: Slingshot Zobo
units.description: A ranged Grass Zobo that shoots deflecting bullets.
units.lore: Slingshot Zobo is obsessed with achieving the perfect parabola. Before every projectile attack, it performs lengthy formula calculations to optimize its trajectory. Teaches other Zobos physics as a hobby.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Shoots bullets to deal damage. On hit, bullets ricochet once to hit another enemy in range.

units.name: Bombard Zobo
units.description: A Fire Zobo that throws bombs to deal damage.
units.lore: Bombard Zobo saves the best part for last by cooking a bomb and throwing it just one second before detonation. This exhilarating game of gamble has cost Bombard Zobo more than a few teammates.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws a bomb that detonates after a delay.

units.name: Spritz Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo that uses a water cannon for sustained attacks.
units.lore: Spritz Zobo is a role-model environmentalist among Zobos. Whenever outdoors, it happily waters roadside flowers and grass, ensuring a world of thriving plant life.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Launches water bombs to deal damage. Sprays water continuously to deal damage while moving slowly, then stops after a certain duration.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses an additional attack.

units.name: Retriever Zobo
units.description: A Zobo that jumps back and forth in tandem with golf balls.
units.lore: Picks up golf balls dutifully but secretly steals all the fancy shiny ones from the boss. They sell at a decent enough price for extra snacks.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws golf balls back and forth in turn to either deal damage or teleport to the ball's location.

units.name: Laborer Zobo
units.description: A Zobo that uses rocks for ranged attacks.
units.lore: Works in deplorable conditions under the sun every day. Secretly swapped out stone for rotten wood when laying the foundations in hopes that the tower might fall one day.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Uses rocks to deal AoE damage that diminishes with distance. Only attacks after entering a certain range toward the bottom of the battlefield.

units.name: Thorn Zobo
units.description: A Zobo that can counter attacks.
units.lore: Thorn Zobo slept in mud for too long and got tangled up in thorns. It's too hard to sort through the mess, so they're just natural armor now. As long as the thorns aren't poking through, there's no need to change shirts. Like, ever.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Strikes a stance to deal counterattacks upon receiving damage from enemies.

units.name: Waitress Zobo
units.description: A Zobo that wields a knife and fork to deal AoE damage.
units.lore: Waitress Zobo works near a volcano so it's got a bit of a hot temper. Fantasizes a lot about turning customers into ingredients instead, so you'll have to forgive the occasional stolen bite.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Wields a knife and fork to deal AoE damage in arcs.

units.name: Curling Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo that throws curling stones to deal AoE damage.
units.lore: Curling Zobo is undefeated in the sport of curling. If it's down on points, it simply hurls its opponent out of the rink like a stone. When a referee once stepped in for a penalty, Curling Zobo set a new personal record for the longest slide distance.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Throws a curling stone to deal damage. Sometimes throws a winning stone that deals AoE damage.

units.name: Biker Zobo
units.description: A Fire Zobo that rides its motorcycle diagonally.
units.lore: "That thing caught up to my motorcycle just by running, and kept chasing me even after falling into a ditch! If it wasn't trying to bite my face off, I would have recruited it into my crew." —Fire Dojo Master, Lobert

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Rides a motorcycle at high speed diagonally. Abandons the motorcycle when Frail or obstructed, which then explodes to deal AoE damage and inflict Burn. Attacks bare-handed afterwards.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses a normal attack after leaving the vehicle.

skills.name: Special skill 2
skills.description: Deals a linked Burn damage tick.

units.name: Bush Zobo
units.description: A Grass Zobo that can hide in bushes to take less damage.
units.lore: Experienced trainers know better than to go poking around in the weeds, as the weeds might poke back! If you spot two clumps of foliage shuffling down the road, don't be curious. Just run!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings a bush to deal damage. After moving a certain distance, hides and gains DMG Reduction before reappearing while Fragile. Enough Burn damage will cause it to appear early.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Hides in the bushes.

units.name: Genie Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo that splits in two after taking a certain amount of damage.
units.lore: Wish Disclaimer: Genie Zobo grants 3 wishes, but on a shoestring budget. Wishing for "instant wealth" will result in a mountain of rotten meat falling from the sky, while "eternal life" will transform you into a taxidermy specimen. Choose your wording carefully.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Claws ahead to deal damage. When Frail, splits into 2 clones in neighboring columns.

units.name: Sign Zobo
units.description: A Lightning Zobo that shocks itself.
units.lore: Sign Zobo once helped build countless skyscrapers, but never owned a single room in them. Now, the entire wasteland is a construction site, but nobody's rushing to finish the project. Sign Zobo still holds onto that sign anyway.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings a road sign to deal damage. Sometimes releases an AoE shockwave that also damages itself.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Delivers an electric shock.

units.name: Welder Zobo
units.description: A Rock Zobo that loses its mask after taking a certain number of hits.
units.lore: Driven by an obsession to seal all gaps and cracks, Welder Zobo insists on welding everything shut with sludge. Nothing is spared: camp gates, parked cars, and even fleeing survivors.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Sprays sludge that deals damage and inflicts Weak. After taking several hits, the mask will shatter and Welder Zobo also gains Weak when attacking.

units.name: Two-Headed Zobo
units.description: A stronger Ordinary Zobo.
units.lore: Does growing an extra head make Zobos more powerful? Probably not.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings its club forcefully to deal damage.

units.name: Goonch Zobo
units.description: A Water Zobo that jumps between routes to keep you on your toes.
units.lore: Looney's "Zobos hate water" theory just got fish-slapped by this Zobo. No more pool parties.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Launches a water orb that deals AoE damage. Teleports to other rows.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Teleports to another lane.

units.name: Popstar Zobo
units.description: A Lightning Zobo that summons a mob of crazed fans.
units.lore: Think about this. Rocker Zobos just have to dance. Pop Star Zobos have to perform.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings its microphone to deal damage. Summons Rocker Zobos.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Supports allied Zobos.

units.name: Roadhog Zobo
units.description: A Rock Zobo that smashes through everything in its way.
units.lore: It planned to take a whole truck, but that was... a bit heavy. So it settled for using the tire instead.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings a heavy tire that deals AoE damage. Unleashes a three-hit combo to smash enemies.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Performs a three-hit combo that flattens enemies.

units.name: Tipsy Zobo
units.description: A powerful Fire Zobo who buffs other Zobos.
units.lore: Zobologist Billy Babbo discovered that Zobos are much bolder after a drink because of their DNA.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Hurls wine bottles that deal damage. Inspires all Zobos, granting them Haste and DMG Boost.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Inspires all Zobos.

units.name: Manager Zobo
units.description: A powerful Grass Zobo that can summon Clerk Zobos.
units.lore: Work your way up to this Zobo, and you'll have an endless brain buffet plus all the pinballs you want!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Hurls flower vases to deal damage. Summons Clerk Zobos. Loses HP when its summons are knocked down.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Summons Zobos with a stamp.

units.name: Shocker Zobo
units.description: A powerful Lightning Zobo that can electrify a large area.
units.lore: This Zobo will give troublemakers, unruly Tatari, and even you a jolt-tastic wake-up call!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swipes with a defibrillator to deal damage. Unleashes multiple electric shocks over an increasing distance, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses electric shocks with an expanding area.

units.name: Shaman Zobo
units.description: A powerful Grass Zobo who gains shields and calls Hanger-On Zobos to its aid.
units.lore: A traditionalist who won't spend two mana every turn summoning just a random totem. Relax.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings bone clubs to deal damage. Summons Hanger-On Zobos and gains Hanger-On: Shield. Loses shield value when the Hanger-On Zobos die.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Summons two Faith Zobos.

units.name: Sandworm Zobo
units.description: A powerful Rock Zobo who relocates the enemy.
units.lore: Everyone thought Zobos would always be humanoid. Until this one slithered in. Ah, natural wonders.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Spits mud bullets that deal damage. Uses quicksand to reposition enemies.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Creates a quicksand trap.

units.name: Volcano Zobo
units.description: A powerful Fire Zobo who explodes multiple times and revives.
units.lore: "ART IS..." Wait, that line's been taken. "ART IS A VOLCANO!"

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings stone fists to deal damage. Upon being destroyed the first few times, explodes to deal AoE damage, then resurrects.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Explodes on death.

units.name: Yeti Zobo
units.description: A powerful Water Zobo who freezes enemies.
units.lore: Left fist hits hard, right fist hits harder. Yeti Zobo is ready for yet another fight!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Attacks alternate between light and heavy punches. Heavy punches deal AoE damage and inflict Freeze. Upon entering the battlefield, summons a blizzard that deals large AoE damage.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Summons a blizzard that freezes enemies across the battlefield.

units.name: Clown Zobo
units.description: A powerful Lightning Zobo who can leap over enemies as it moves.
units.lore: "Sorry, the Zobo you have called is currently piloting a helicopter. Please call again later."

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Flies onto the battlefield. After landing, uses dual blades to deal damage.

units.name: Sailor Zobo
units.description: A powerful Water Zobo who summons multiple barrels.
units.lore: Maybe this Zobo was possessed by a Kraken‑like creature? Otherwise, how did an octopus turn from "dinner "into "killer"?

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Rolls and summons multiple barrels that deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Summons one barrel in each lane.

skills.name: Special skill 2
skills.description: Rolls out a barrel.

skills.name: Special skill 3
skills.description: Rolls out a barrel.

units.name: Climber Zobo
units.description: A powerful Rock Zobo who can target multiple zones.
units.lore: Climber Zobo once had a somewhat graphic animation of hooking over a Tatari with its axe for a beatdown. For various reasons, the idea ended up scrapped.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings a pickaxe to deal damage. Can trigger ground tremors that periodically deal AoE damage.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses a special area attack.

skills.name: Special skill 2
skills.description: Uses a special area attack.

units.name: Garden Zobo
units.description: A powerful Grass Zobo who entangles enemies.
units.lore: Its lab coat looks eerily similar to one worn by a certain researcher, except its pocket is marked with a P, not an A.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Shoots seeds that deal damage. Tosses vines to inflict Garden: Entangled on enemies.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses a special area attack.

skills.name: Special skill 2
skills.description: Applies a buff multiplier.

units.name: Forge Zobo
units.description: A powerful Fire Zobo who launches other Zobos.
units.lore: The limits and constraints imposed by ordinary feeble bodies are simply unacceptable. Glorious Evolution!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Launches fireballs that deal damage. Pulls allies in, then launches them.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Uses a special area attack.

units.name: Knight Zobo
units.description: A powerful Grass Zobo that does charge attacks.
units.lore: The giant! It's making its final charge toward the giant ahead!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Continuously gains Haste while moving. Its first attack after gaining Haste inflicts Stun and deals massive damage.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Accelerates continuously. The first attack at maximum speed deals area damage and stuns.

skills.name: Special skill 2
skills.description: Accelerates continuously. The first attack at maximum speed deals area damage and stuns.

units.name: Pharaoh Zobo
units.description: A powerful Rock Zobo whose attacks become more devastating over time.
units.lore: "Doesn't it get tired from shooting beams all day?" "That's how it was designed. No stopping until you die!" —Dev Chat

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Summons multiple attackable coffins and appears from the last one destroyed. Applies a death curse which repeatedly inflicts Fragile that stacks.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Starts inside a set of coffins. Destroyed coffins release Zobos; the final coffin releases Pharaoh Zobo, whose death ray increases in damage.

units.name: Captain Zobo
units.description: A Fire Zobo that can switch between attack modes.
units.lore: For Captain Zobo, not all treasure is silver and gold.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Fires its weapon to attack at range, generating gold coins. When coins are picked up, recovers HP and gains ATK Boost, before switching to a blade for melee attacks.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Drops coins after shooting. Picking up coins increases its attack and restores HP, then it switches to a flaming blade.

units.name: Hydro Zobo
units.description: A powerful Water Zobo that can fire multiple shots.
units.lore: Hydro Zobo used to be handsome. Some weight gain was unfortunate, but all the exes are still gorgeous Zobo models.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Launches water bombs that deal damage. Upon losing a certain amount of HP, launches water bombs at multiple random targets. Subsequent water bombs are weaker.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Fires level-3 water shots. Each 33% HP lost triggers shots at multiple random targets and lowers the shot level by one, up to twice.

units.name: Laser Zobo
units.description: A powerful Lightning Zobo that enhances attacks by collecting parts.
units.lore: Muhaha, fallen Zobos are just what I need to power my reactor. Instant fuel! Max output now!

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Periodically generates cogs nearby, occasionally firing a piercing laser. Collects cogs on the field to increase the laser's duration. When present, other Zobos will drop cogs when they die.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Fires lightning and collects parts to strengthen it. Other Zobos drop parts when they die while it is present.

units.name: Harpoon Zobo
units.description: A powerful Water Zobo that wields a harpoon and coordinates fish attacks.
units.lore: Harpoon Zobo harvests fish in the depths during the day and waiters at the sushi place at night. Complains non-stop about back pain and might quit any day now, but those shiny new diving gear aren't cheap, so it's either the sea or the tables.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Fires a harpoon to deal damage. Sometimes fires a marking shot that deals AoE damage and attracts fish to continuously attack.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: No player-facing description is recorded for this helper skill.

units.name: Golf Zobo
units.description: A powerful Lightning Zobo that attacks with a golf club and specialized golf balls.
units.lore: This jacked Zobo just won a golf championship. Loves giving brain electrotherapy with a short-circuiting golf club and claims its the best way to clear up negative thoughts.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings a golf club to deal damage. Sometimes launches a specialized piercing ball that deals damage in its path and ricochets across edges of the map.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: No player-facing description is recorded for this helper skill.

units.name: Totem Zobo
units.description: A powerful Rock Zobo that deals AoE damage while advancing and cannot be easily stopped.
units.lore: Welcome to the sacred temple ruins! Please refrain from making loud noises, littering, or picking flowers from the wreaths on Totem Zobo. Unless you want a totem-shaped lesson on responsible tourism.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Venerates and deals damage to nearby enemies, while granting nearby Zobos Haste and DEF Boost. Won't stop before reaching the edge of the map.

units.name: Botanical Zobo
units.description: A powerful Grass Zobo with attackable arms and torso.
units.lore: The right head prefers chomping enemies, and the left head insists on photosynthesis-only. The actual head in the middle just thinks they're both useless and distracting.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Shoots strange seeds that deal AoE damage. Both arms and the body can be attacked.

units.name: Chef Zobo
units.description: A powerful Fire Zobo that can enhance its attacks.
units.lore: "Leaving a negative review. The volcanic smoke-free grill sounds cool but the owner is incredibly rude. I asked to speed up my order and got chased around by gigantic skewers. Do they even have hygiene standards?" —Apocalypse Foodie Blog

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Wields skewers to deal small AoE damage. Sprinkles salt to season skewers for greater range and additional Burn.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: No player-facing description is recorded for this helper skill.

units.name: Brainfreeze Zobo
units.description: A powerful Water Zobo that summons ice paths.
units.lore: Brainfreeze Zobo can withstand even absolute zero temperatures, as long as alcohol's involved. To maintain the illusion that it's absolutely not freezing to death, however, it has to down half a bottle after waking up every day.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Swings bottles to deal damage and lays down 3 ice-paved paths in front. Zobos on the ice paths continuously gain Haste, but retreat a greater distance when inflicted with Knockback.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: No player-facing description is recorded for this helper skill.

units.name: Driver Zobo
units.description: A powerful Lightning Zobo that summons vehicles.
units.lore: Never try to cut off Driver Zobo. Whatever that thing's driving has no brake system, and you'll just become a single-use speed bump.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Summons small vehicles that charge forward and deal damage to enemies in their path. Vehicles will attack from different directions onto locked on targets, and can be blocked by shields.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Targets a tile occupied by a Tatari and launches vehicles from five directions, damaging the paths and target.

units.name: Baron Zobo
units.description: A powerful Rock Zobo that gains buffs from gemstones.
units.lore: Rules of the mine: 1. Run when you see the one holding a cigar; 2. If you can't run, turn in all your stones immediately; 3. Don't ever think about taking what's in the bag, unless you want to be slaving underground forever.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Scatters treasure and sometimes throws gemstones to deal damage. When treasure is retrieved, recovers a small amount of HP, gains Treasure: ATK Boost, and increases the pierce limit of gemstones.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: No player-facing description is recorded for this helper skill.

units.name: Tire Zobo
units.description: A powerful Grass Zobo that rolls and attacks in a tire.
units.lore: Tire Zobo got stuck in a tire one day, and ever since the world has just been one endless roll. Seriously, Tire Zobo is too dizzy to even think properly anymore. But I guess brains are overrated when a tire's charging at you at full speed.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Rolls forward with increasing speed when spawned, and can also roll left or right to deal damage. Gains Fragile when rolling. Roll speed will decrease after being hit multiple times.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Transforms into a tire and rolls sideways.

skills.name: Special skill 2
skills.description: Transforms into a tire and rolls sideways.

units.name: Hammer Zobo
units.description: A powerful Fire Zobo that can charge and deal large AoE attacks.
units.lore: This world really sucks. Instead of trying to fit in, Hammer Zobo decided to oil up the hammer and smash it to bits.

skills.name: Primary skill
skills.description: Wields a hammer to deal damage. Deals AoE damage when the hammer is charged. If multiple enemies are within range, damage will reverberate backwards.

skills.name: Special skill 1
skills.description: Deals charged AoE damage. If multiple enemies are within hit range, damage will reverberate backwards.

notes.stats: ATK, HP and DEF are recorded growth multipliers, not fixed battle stats. Final values depend on enemy level, stars and mode scaling.
notes.horde: Horde uses this Zobo’s shared skills. No separate Horde skill upgrades are recorded in the audited enemy skill links. Difficulty, wave scaling and mode effects can still change combat.
